basic_info.description: Inner Sunset beauty with classic lines. Regal wooden staircase at the entry. Bright and airy single-family house with attached garage and backyard. Formal living room and dining room. Original wood trim and hardwood floors. Kitchen has been refreshed. A compact, full bathroom next to the breakfast den. Three bedrooms on the top floor and a full bathroom. Main level has a sliding glass door to a deck and stairs to the backyard. Internal stairs to garage. 98-walk score, adjacent to the Irving Street commercial corridor. One block to public transportation. Minutes to UCSF. Near the Park Presidio artery for ease of commute.
